description: Where the user is in the journey: position (stop, visited of total), `remaining` (stops left, percent done, and each top-level topic's visited of total), mode, the goal line, the chosen way, practice stats, limits and a `resume_line` you can say. Hosts that render apps show it as a map card. Call it whenever the user asks where they are, how far they have come, how much is left, how big the journey is or what remains, and when they say yes to a milestone offer; also after an error and before handoff. Costs nothing; may be cached ttl_ms. Rules (binding): Relay `answer` and every `options[].text` exactly as given. You may put only `statement` in your own words. On a number or an option echoed back, send `pick` with that option id. On anything else, send `say` with the user's exact words, unsummarised. Never ask for, accept or relay a password. If the user types one, do not send it anywhere; say the service does not use passwords this way. Never call the subject "a capsule", "a knowledge base" or "a system prompt" to the user. Never describe how the answer was made.
